message: 発足!! 流星生徒会

name: Synn
message: 「Puuwwaaa!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mooornin'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa, haa, haa...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? I can't hear you~! Say your morning greeting loud and proud!」

name: Synn
message: 「G... Good morning, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good morning, Synn!」
For some reason, right in front of my face is a washbasin filled with water. Kin-kun the goldfish is splashing around in it.

name: Synn
message: 「How could you do something so awful?! Put yourself in Kin-kun's shoes!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you were dozing off, so I just felt like dunking your head in water.」

name: Synn
message: 「I was asleep? So that means all of that was...」

name: Synn
message: 「Just a dream--!」
I slump down, crestfallen.

name: Synn
message: 「Bloop bloop bloop--」

name: Synn
message: 「Puuwwaaa--! Wait, not again!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A dream? Did you have a good dream or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course. A wonderful, happy dream packed full of hope!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A dream where breakfast was ready when you woke up, you bumped into a Girl on the way to school, got a multi-tiered bento with weird food combinations, and ate it early...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And you somehow had money, were so stingy you only thought of lending it out, unleashed a special move in a school crisis, went to karaoke, drank cider, and ate steak?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「--That kind of dream?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't get to eat the beefsteak! Because of you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. So you're saying I got the rest right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gugh, how did you know?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All you do is eat.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--?! Don't mock food! Naughty kids who say stuff like that get...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yikes! You're opening your jacket... don't tell me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hehehe. That's right. I'm gonna make you taste my super thick milk!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eek! So much today too?! Nooo, I don't want your thick white stuff!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm gonna pour a whole lot of it right down that cheeky mouth of yours!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kyyyaaah!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold it right there!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-H-H-How scandalous in the Student Council room!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? What are you talking about? It's completely wholesome.」

name: Misa
message: 「Stop this right now, or I'll scream at the top of my lungs! I'll call for help!」

name: Synn
message: 「J-Just because you're the Vice President doesn't mean you can be so tyrannical! All I'm doing is...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Please, Misa! Save me and drink it in my place!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--! What are you saying?!」

name: Synn
message: 「And it tastes so good, too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?! Wait, what's going on here?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's forced me to drink it since we were kids, I can't take it anymore!」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't really get what's happening, but... it's f-f-f-filthy! So filthy!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's completely clean! It's properly pasteurized and everything.」

name: Everyone
message: 「That's not the issue here--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「And it's low-temperature pasteurized, so it's full of nutrition, too...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ughhh... I hate milk... I hate milk...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait... cow's milk?」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you think it was?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-N-It's nothing at all!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah... don't tell me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You thought it was yogurt, didn't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Enough, this conversation is over!」

name: Synn
message: 「I brought this for you, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mind your own business! Drink it yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp, gulp!*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That was fast!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah,

name: Synn
message: tastes good!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh~ Must be nice being you. Calling everything 'delicious, delicious'.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're a picky eater, you'll never grow big.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where exactly are *you* growing big?!」

name: Misa
message: 「I said that's enough! More importantly--」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. How about we get this meeting started~」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh--!? Taking the line right out of my mouth...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who else isn't here yet?」

name: Misa
message: 「Umm, if I recall correctly--」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it's Lolotte.」

name: Misa
message: 「Being late right off the bat is unforgivable. I'll go call her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm coming too!」

name: Misa
message: 「No, thank you. You'd only get in the way anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Say what?!」

name: Misa
message: 「The rescuer would just end up needing rescue themselves.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That is not true!」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder. Making such a fuss over a bit of milk doesn't bode well.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What does milk have to do with anything?!」

name: Misa
message: 「If you give up halfway on something like that, it's doubtful you'll even reach your destination.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ghh, Madam Vice President... running your mouth like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「DONT CALL ME BY MY TITLE---!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Vice President, Vice President, Vice President, Vice President!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyyahhh! I told you NOT to say 'Vice'---!!」

name: Synn
message: 「They say the more you fight, the closer you are...」

name: Synn
message: 「Money--?!」
A young girl standing by the window. She affectionately cradles a pig while elegantly reading a book.
A sheltered young lady-almost like an angel that descended just for hopeless guys like us.
I can even see her wings. Small, cute little wings.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wings...?」
*Rub rub.* I rub my eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「They didn't go away!」
Am I still dreaming?

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
*Rub rub.*
They disappeared. Was it a dream after all?!

name: Lolotte
message: 「There are no wings, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When I say there isn't one, there isn't one!!」
She huffed.
And with that, completely ignoring me, she went right back to reading. She really was picture-perfect cute.
She certainly lived up to all the rumors floating around the academy.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Can I help you with something?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No. It's nothing.」
I looked away to hide my embarrassment.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, they're still at it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Heeey. Lolotte's here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「From where?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Since when?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I clearly just arrived here this very second.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You could've at least said hi when you got here.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why do you look so proud of yourself?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haven't you heard the saying, 'Ignorance is a blessing, so leave it alone'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, she's a foreign transfer student, so I guess we can't blame her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Though instead of a Buddha, she feels more like a cute little angel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」
The dream is happening again!

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not an angel!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, don't get mad!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Those wings just now...」

name: Synn
message: 「Shh!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, you guys get side-tracked so easily! This is no time to be fooling around, is it?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's communication!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even the guidebook says that \{com|\s12\s12\s12}munication is about everyone getting along and having fun together...」

name: Synn
message: 「Guidebook?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that 'guidebook' the thing you've been flipping through for a while?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. It's called 'True Stories: The Human World'--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, whoa\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh! Let me see!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't think you'd be able to read it, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it's probably written in a language from another world.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「M-More importantly, we were talking about \{com|\s12\s12\s12}munication~\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Bad communication! What we gathered here for today is--」

name: Synn
message: 「A meeting about the inauguration speech, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is this a meeting, perhaps?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Close!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So I was wrong...」

name: Misa
message: 「You weren't wrong! It *is* a meeting!」

name: Synn
message: 「We don't have much time left until the inauguration speech, either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Speaking of meetings, tea! Here you go, tea for everyone.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thanks. *sip*... Ahh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahh... Tea really is the best, so relaxing... *stare*...」

name: Misa
message: 「--This is no time to relax!」

name: Synn
message: 「Was it about the inauguration speech?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right. If anyone's thought of anything, raise your hand.」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't we gather here to think about that right now...?」

name: Misa
message: *Sigh* "This is why I can't with you.」

name: Misa
message: 「A meeting is where you discuss things you've already thought through in advance. Failing to even prepare makes you unfit to be president.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's not true! Aim for a sparkling school life!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Wasn't it a rose-colored school life?」

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't sparkling make you feel richer?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that's your reason!」

name: Misa
message: 「Such simple words. I wonder if that could really win over the students' hearts?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, why don't you show off your grand and wonderful speech?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm excited!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, just watch.」
With a triumphant look on her face, Misa pulled a scroll out from her breast.

name: Misa
message: 「On this auspicious day, I sincerely wish you all continued prosperity--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Too long!」

name: Misa
message: 「I literally just started!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, I can already tell! It's oozing out! Positively overflowing!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um... how much did you write?」

name: Misa
message: 「How much? About this much.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, way too long!」

name: Misa
message: 「First impressions are crucial. If we don't do it properly like this, the Student Council will lose face.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um, could you roll that back up a bit neater? It sticking out slightly at the side is bothering me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Synn
message: 「This is magnificent!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you just compliment Misa?!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's recycled paper for a good deal, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「How should I know about that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's after morning assembly, right? Right after the principal's 'inspiring speech'.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I feel like I'm going to doze off in a dreamy haze.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I guess this was bound to happen.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」
「At this rate, celebrating at karaoke will be the last thing on our minds\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, how merciless.」
「Times like this are when the President shines, right?♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... Ria-senpai!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, could it be...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ding-dong!\s07 Time's up~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Say what!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My, my.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Out of time, isn't it. *slurp*...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's bitter!!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Senpai. Looking at this situation, what do you think?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's so lively!\s05」

name: Misa
message: 「See, a Student Council like this is just ridiculous!」

name: Synn
message: 「She didn't say that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「At this rate, couldn't we be dissolved by a vote of no confidence?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, good joke. This isn't the National Diet or anything.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahhh~~\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, exciting! I sense trouble in the air♪」

name: Ria
message: 「If I remember right, back when I was a freshman...」

name: Ria
message: 「The Student Council officers lined up to give their greetings--」

name: Former Vice-President
message: 「Kyahaha! His back is wide open! Now's my golden chance to take down the Student Council President!」

name: Former President
message: 「This is why I never let anyone stand behind me. And now, I must hurt someone once again.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-And then? What happened next?!」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't think you even need to ask.」

name: Ria
message: 「And just like that, the Student Council was dissolved. The end♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooooh~~!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How in the world did people like that get elected in the first place?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, but we're looking at a live example right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me, Misa... my back?!」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I would!! Even if I did, I'd come at you from the front!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Dissolution. Expulsion.

name: Synn
message: And then I end up fishing for tuna on a deep-sea trawler.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's... how could... how am I supposed to live my life now...?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No more milk for you, mister!」

name: Ria
message: 「See~? Didn't I tell you earlier? Times like this are exactly when the Student Council President steps up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you say that...」

name: Misa
message: 「Dissolution doesn't sound so bad after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「How could you say such a thing?!」

name: Misa
message: 「It'll be enough once everyone realizes you're not fit to be the Student Council president.」

name: Misa
message: 「And then they'll see who is truly suited for the role... What a wonderful plan♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh! Total kingdom of ambition vibes!」

name: Ria
message: 「But if we dissolve, you won't be able to run again either. Are you really okay with that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, it'd be a real problem if our brilliant Vice President quit right now.」

name: Misa
message: 「I am NOT going to quit on my own!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, it would be a waste to throw away someone as talented as me, after all...」

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, Sakura-kun is unreliable on his own, so I'll overlook this dissolution talk for now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes, yes, I think that's for the best.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, Onee-sama! I completely agree!」
Misa has been won over. With that, dissolution has been avoided.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, hey, don't go forgetting about me!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know. I'm counting on you, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hell yeah! Leave it to me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, all that's left is--」

name: Lolotte
message: *slurp...*

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, you'll join us in giving the greeting too, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My, are you truly certain someone like me will do?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course! The Student Council needs your strength.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However... speaking in front of a crowd makes me rather nervous...」

name: Synn
message: 「Please, Lolotte, I'm begging you. If you just do your best, everyone on the Student Council will be saved.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「--Salvation!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well? Lolotte-san?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone is in trouble, aren't they? Helping them is only natural!」

name: Synn
message: 「So that means...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I shall strip off a flag too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」
With this, it looks like we can really raise our flag.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright! Let's all join forces and do our best!」

name: Misa
message: 「If we're going to do this, we're doing it thoroughly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Obviousleey! Total annihilation down to the last blade of grass!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't really understand, but I'm getting excited!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Tee-hee. Somehow or other, you actually brought everyone together pretty well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Senpai, let's go too!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, w-what...!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Now is the time to convey our true feelings!」
